thesis: The hosts discuss their personal reading histories, noting that Niklas Savos began reading investing books around age 18 and read approximately 50 books in 2016, while Eddie Palmgen started investing around age 18 and previously read a mix of fiction and finance studies. They explain that their podcast, Investing by the Books, has grown from a website started in 2012 to a platform with over 900 titles in their collection, where episodes are often driven by natural curiosity rather than rigid planning.
